params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Aphelios''' has access to an arsenal of 5 ''Moonstone Weapons'', created by his sister '''Alune'''. He equips two weapons at any one time, one as his {{as|main weapon}} and one as his {{as|off-hand}}. Each weapon has a unique {{tip|basic attack}} and effect.
params.description2: '''Aphelios''' begins the game with {{ai|Calibrum|Aphelios}} as his {{as|main weapon}} and {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} in his {{as|off-hand}}, with {{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}}, {{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}}, and {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}} queued in reserve. His weapons are initially in this order, but they can be rearranged based on their usage.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Moonlight:}} Weapons granted to '''Aphelios''' have 50 ''Moonlight'' for [[ammunition]], which is consumed upon basic attacking {{tip|on-attack}} and upon casting his {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary abilities}}. Any of his abilities that automatically cause him to attack during their effect will not consume additional ''Moonlight''. Once his {{as|main weapon's}} ''Moonlight'' is exhausted, it is moved to the end of the reserve queue; '''Alune''' then assembles his next available weapon from the reserve over 1 second, placing its {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary ability}} on a {{fd|1.5}}-second {{sti|cooldown}} from the start of the assembly. '''Aphelios''' cannot cast ''{{ai|Phase|Aphelios}}'' during the assembly.
params.description4: {{sbc|Innate - Weapon Master:}} '''Aphelios''' cannot improve his abilities via [[Experience (champion)|skill points]]. He starts the game with ''{{ai|Phase|Aphelios}}'' and automatically gains access to his [[File:Q.png|20px|link=]] primary abilities at level 2 and his [[File:R.png|20px|link=]] ultimate ability, ''{{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}}'', at level 6. ''{{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}}'' improves automatically at levels 11 and 16. '''Aphelios''' may spend his skill points to gain {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} or {{sti|{{as|lethality}}}} instead.
params.notes:
* The [[attack damage]], [[attack speed]] and [[lethality]] within '''Aphelios' '''unique rank-up menu in the HUD correspond to the Q, W, E ability rank-up [[hotkey]]s, respectively, for the purposes of assigning skill points via keyboard.
* Due to '''Aphelios''' lacking a fourth rankup option (R), his point assigment does not follow the same rules as other champions.
** For example, the earliest level that an individual statistic can attain rank 6 is level 9, by assigning points at levels {{ap|1|2|3|5|7|9}}.
* An ammunition counter will appear to the right side of the screen when '''Aphelios' '''{{as|main weapon}} has 10 or less ''Moonlight''.
* While at lower than 10 ''Moonlight'', casting his {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary abilities}} will not spend additional ''Moonlight'' but instead consume all the remaining points.
* {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} will not consume additional ''Moonlight'' when firing its bolts.
* The in-game tooltip will reflect the current order of weapons.
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Aphelios}} wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister '''Alune'''. He has access to two at a time: {{as|main weapon}} and {{as|off-hand}} weapon. Each weapon grants him a unique basic attack and a [[File:Q.png|20px|link=]] primary ability.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Moonlight:}} Attacks and abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, '''Aphelios''' discards the weapon to the reserve and '''Alune''' assembles the next of the 5.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Weapon Master:}} '''Aphelios''' cannot improve his abilities with skill points, instead he spend those for '''bonus''' stats: {{as|{{sti|attack damage}}}}, {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}}, and {{as|{{sti|lethality}}}}.

params.description: '''Aphelios''' gains {{sti|range|100 '''bonus''' attack range}} while '''Calibrum''' is his {{as|main weapon}}. Enemies damaged by '''Calibrum''' through an ability are marked for {{fd|4.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. '''Aphelios' ''' next basic attack against a marked target uses the current {{as|off-hand}} weapon and has {{sti|range|1800 range}}, increased missile speed, and a brief cast time that lasts shorter based on '''Aphelios' ''' proximity to the target.
params.description2: The empowered attack will consume the marks from all targets, dealing {{as|15|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to the main target for each mark consumed. If '''Calibrum''' is the current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, the {{as|main weapon}} is used for the attack instead.
params.notes:
* {{ais|Crescendum|Aphelios}} outgoing basic attack can bypass {{cai|W|Yasuo}} and {{cai|E|Braum}} but cannot while returning.
* Triggered ''Marks'' apply on-hit effects, stack {{nie|Energized}} and trigger {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}, but no other [[on-attack effects]].
* The mark will not be triggered by {{ai|Onslaught|Aphelios}} attacks.
* The increased basic attack range is drawn for '''Aphelios''' to differentiate it from his normal attack range.
* The empowered range for the mark will also be drawn as an indicator for '''Aphelios'''.
* {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}} bolts will use '''Calibrum's''' projectiles for '''Aphelios's''' attacks with '''Calibrum'''.
* If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away or no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the empowered attack's cast time, it will still fire despite the target being invalid.{{bug}}
[[File:Calibrum Attack Range screenshot.png|thumb|left|250px|A blue circle outlining the range in which he may perform basic attacks.]]
[[File:Aphelios Calibrum Enhanced Mark Range.png|thumb|left|This glowing indicator will align directly behind each ''marked'' target.]]
params.blurb: {{ci|Aphelios}} has {{as|{{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}}}} while '''Calibrum''' is his {{as|main weapon}}. Abilities will mark targets, and he may attack them from far away with the current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, consuming all marks and dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} for each mark consumed.
params.blurb2: While Calibrum is the {{as|main weapon}}, his [[File:Q.png|20px]] ability will be:

params.description: Basic attacks with '''Severum''' are {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}} and have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}. '''Severum's''' attacks {{tip|heal}} '''Aphelios''' for {{pp|key=%|2 to 8|formula=1.647% + 0.3529% * level, capped at level 18|color=heal}}<!--stops at 18-->  of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt, increased to {{pp|5 to 20|key=%|formula=4.1176% + 0.8824% * level, capped at level 18|color=heal}}<!--stops at 18--> for attacks from abilities.
params.description2: Healing from '''Severum''' in excess of '''Aphelios' ''' {{as|{{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} is converted into a {{tip|shield}} for an amount of up to {{pp|10; then +10*x|1;6 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ 6% '''maximum''' health)}}, lingering for up to 30 seconds.
params.notes: * {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}} bolts will use '''Severum's''' attack animation instead of firing projectiles for '''Aphelios' ''' attacks with '''Severum'''.
params.blurb: {{cis|Aphelios}} basic attacks will {{tip|heal}} him, and create a {{tip|shield}} from excess healing.
params.blurb2: While Severum is the {{as|main weapon}}, his [[File:Q.png|20px]] ability will be:

params.description: Basic attacks with '''Gravitum''' {{tip|slow}} enemies by 30% for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, decaying to 15% after {{fd|0.7}} seconds.
params.notes:
* ''Gravitum's'' debuff applies even if the target is immune to {{tip|slow|slows}} (via {{tip|slow-immune|slow immunity}} or {{tip|cc-immune|cc-immunity}}).
** The only exception is {{cai|E|Skarner}}, which is special cased to negate the debuff with its slow-immunity.
** The target will be affected after losing their immunity.
* {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} bolts will use ''Gravitum's'' projectiles when '''Aphelios''' attacks with ''Gravitum''.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb2: While Gravitum is the {{as|main weapon}}, his [[File:Q.png|20px]] ability will be:

params.description: Basic attacks with '''Infernum''' shoot a fire bolt that upon arrival splits into a cone of 4 lesser bolts behind the target, dealing damage to enemies they pass through. The fire bolt deals {{as|110% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to the primary target. Secondary targets hit by any bolt are dealt {{pp|key=%|75;100|1;9|formula=75% + 25% at level 9}} of the triggering {{as|attack's damage}}, reduced to {{pp|key=%|23;30|1;9|formula=23% + 7% at level 9}} against {{tip|minions}}.
params.description2: {{tip|Critical strike|Critical strikes}} instead spray 6 missiles in a 50% wider cone. Secondary targets hit count as being {{tip|critical strike|critically struck}}.
params.notes:
* The main target is dealt {{tip|basic damage}}, while secondary ones are dealt {{tip|area damage|area}} {{tip|basic damage|basic}} {{tip|proc damage}} without applying {{tip|spell effects}}.
* ''Infernum's'' attack hit can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} by or {{tip|blind|missed}} against the primary target. 
** This will not prevent the missile from dealing damage to secondary targets nor from splashing against additional targets behind the primary target. The damage cannot be dodged as or missed against a secondary target.
* {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}} bolts will use ''Infernum's'' projectiles when '''Aphelios''' attacks with ''Infernum''.
** The bolts' attacks shoot 3 missiles, increased to 5 missiles when they {{tip|critically strike}}.
params.blurb: {{cis|Aphelios}} basic attacks will hit all enemies in its trajectory, dealing increased damage to the main target and less damage to other targets. The attack will then spread into a cone behind his main target.
params.blurb2: While Infernum is the {{as|main weapon}}, his [[File:Q.png|20px]] ability will be:

params.description: Basic attacks with '''Crescendum''' hurl the blade at the target, which lingers for {{fd|0.2}} seconds before homing back to '''Aphelios'''. He is unable to declare basic attacks until he retrieves '''Crescendum''', but the attack timer is reset {{tt|once caught|This does not persist when swapping weapons.}}.
params.description2: Whenever '''Aphelios''' casts an ability that would require him to throw '''Crescendum''', he instead fires a spectral ''Chakram'' at the target that similarly returns to him. '''Aphelios''' accumulates the ''Chakrams'' he catches, up to 20, which last for 5 seconds or until '''Crescendum''' is depleted of ''Moonlight''. ''Chakram'' duration is refreshed when '''Aphelios''' catches a new one or attacks a {{tip|champion}} with '''Crescendum'''.
params.description3: Attacks with '''Crescendum''' are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|0;then + 16; then + 14.5; then + 13; then + 11.5; then + 10; then + 8.5; then + 7; then + 5.5; then + 5*x|0 to 20 by 1|type=number of Chakrams|key=%|formula=Each Chakram grants less bonus damage than the last, starting at 16% and diminishing to 5% for 9+ Chakrams.}} AD}} {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}} and have a lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} of {{ap|0.159999996423721/1.5*100|round=2}}%, further decreased to {{ap|0.100000001490116/1.5*100|round=2}}% when {{tip|critically strike|critically striking}}. The '''bonus''' damage from ''Chakrams'' is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
params.custominfo: {{pp|5000 to 5000-6000*0.55|0 to 0.55 by 0.05|label=Missile Speed|label1=Time (s)|formula=5000 u/s initial speed, -6000 u/s² acceleration, and a minimum speed of 1700|showtype=false}}
params.notes:
* All ''Chakram'' stacks are lost if the '''Crescendum''' projectile is destroyed (i.e {{ai|W|Yasuo}}, {{ai|E|Braum}}).
* Due to the return time, at high attack speeds '''Crescendum''' will increase '''Aphelios' '''effective time to cast attacks, even when right next to his target.
* {{pending for test}} Crescendum attack cannot exceed attack speed limit<!--what does it mean?-->
params.blurb: {{ci|Aphelios}} throws a chakram as his basic attack and he cannot attack again until it returns to him. Other abilities will create mirror chakrams that he gathers, and his basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on how many mirror chakrams he holds.
params.blurb2: While Crescendum is the {{as|main weapon}}, his [[File:Q.png|20px]] ability will be:

params.description: The active effect of '''Aphelios'''' [[File:Q.png|20px|link=]] varies based on his current {{as|main weapon}}.
params.description2: The individual actives do not share a cooldown.
params.blurb:
The active effect of {{cis|Aphelios}} [[File:Q.png|20px]] ability varies based on his current {{as|main weapon}}.
*{{ai|Calibrum|Aphelios}} - {{ai|Moonshot|Aphelios}}: Long range shot that marks its target for a long-range follow-up attack.
*{{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} - {{ai|Onslaught|Aphelios}}: Gain {{as|'''bonus''' {{sti|movement speed}}}} while attacking a single enemy with both weapons.
*{{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}} - {{ai|Binding Eclipse|Aphelios}}: {{tip|Root}} enemies who are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by this weapon.
*{{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}} - {{ai|Duskwave|Aphelios}}: Blast enemies in a cone and attack them with your {{as|off-hand}} weapon.
*{{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}} - {{ai|Sentry|Aphelios}}: Deploy a sentry with your {{as|off-hand}} weapon that attacks nearby enemies.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|{{pp|80 to 170 for 7|1 to 13 for 7}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pp|42 to 60 for 7|1 to 13 for 7|key=%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' enters an onslaught for {{fd|1.75}} seconds, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|25%|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 10% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} and automatically performing up to 6 {{as|(+ 2 per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)|attack speed}} attacks over the duration against the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy, prioritizing enemy {{tip|champions}}.
params.description2: Attacks alternate between ''Severum'' and his current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, each dealing {{as|{{pp|20 to 41 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness. '''Aphelios''' cannot perform attacks while affected by {{tip|disarming crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables basic attacks.
params.description3: '''''Aphelios''' cannot cast {{ai|Phase|Aphelios}} nor {{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}} during Onslaught, but he is still able to move.''
params.notes:
* '''Severum's''' attacks are not {{tip|projectile|intercepted}}, but the attacks from the {{as|off-hand}} weapon are during ''Onslaught''.
* '''Aphelios''' will also not perform the attacks while channeling {{si|Recall}}.
* Each attack of ''Onslaught'' counts as a separate {{tip|cast instance}} for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}} and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.
* If '''Aphelios''' is {{tip|taunt|taunted}}, he will still attack the nearest enemy.
* During ''Onslaught'', '''Aphelios' ''' {{sti|attack range|link=range}} is reduced{{ft|to 410|by 140}}and his attack commands instead issue movement commands to walk into the respective range of his target.
* ''Onslaught's'' attacks stack {{tip|Energized}}, but do not apply any other {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
* ''Onslaught'' begins firing with '''Aphelios'''' {{as|off-hand}} weapon.
** This means that, if used with {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}}, it will generate [''n'' ÷ 2] ''Chakrams'' for even numbers of hits, and [(''n'' - 1) ÷ 2 + 1] ''Chakrams'' for odd numbers of hits.
* {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}} will not deal damage if blocked by {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}}, but the stacks will still be gained.
* Cosmetically, the ''Moonlight'' cost is consumed through the duration.
<!--Blurb-->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' gains {{as|'''bonus''' {{sti|movement speed}}}} and quickly attacks a nearby enemy with {{ai|Severum|Aphelios|border=false}} and his current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, dealing {{as|physical damage}}. The number of attacks is increased based on {{as|his '''bonus''' attack speed}}.

params.description: {{sbc|{{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}} - Active:}} '''Aphelios''' expunges all enemies with ''Gravitum's'' {{tip|slow}} debuff, dealing {{as|{{pp|50 to 140 for 7|1 to 13}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{pp|32 to 50 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for 1 second.
params.description2: ''An enemy affected by Gravitum, or an in-flight Gravitum projectile, is required to cast this ability. In-flight projectiles will be empowered to apply Binding Eclipse's effects to their targets.''
params.notes:
* No compensations are made if ''Binding Eclipse'' is used to empower in-flight ''Gravitum'' projectiles that are {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroyed}} or have the slow application negated by any means, wasting the effect in the process.
* ''Binding Eclipse'' cannot expunge enemies affected by ''Gravitum'' that are {{tip|untargetable}}.
<!--Blurb-->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|roots}} all targets that are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by {{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios|border=false}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' unleashes a wave of energy in a cone in the target direction over the cast time, dealing {{as|{{pp|20 to 110 for 7|1 to 13}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pp|15 to 21 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies hit and locking onto each of them. After {{fd|0.25}} seconds, '''Aphelios''' then fires a volley of attacks at each locked-on target from his current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, dealing {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. The damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers. There is no {{sti|range}} limit for locked-on targets.
params.notes:
* The volley applies {{tip|area damage}} and the follow up attacks from the {{as|off-hand}} weapon deal {{tip|basic damage}}.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
*The hitbox also includes a very small portion behind '''Aphelios'''' character model.
* '''Aphelios''' is locked out of declaring attacks until the volley of attacks has resolved.
* The automatic attacks do not trigger '''any''' [[on-attack effects]].
** {{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}} does not increase the damage of the volley.
* The volley of attacks won't deal any damage, if they are {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, or if '''Aphelios''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
<!--Blurb-->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' unleashes a wave of energy in a cone, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and locking on to each of them, basic attacking them after a delay.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' deploys a lunar sentry at the target location that arms after {{fd|0.35}} seconds, lasting for up to 20 seconds, during which it is inactive and {{tip|untargetable}}. The sentry activates if an enemy is within range of it, reducing its duration to 4 seconds and becoming targetable. Sentries have {{as|6 health}} and take 3 damage per {{tip|ranged}} basic attack and 4 damage per hit by abilities. {{tip|Turret}} attacks destroy sentries instantly.
params.description2: The sentry grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and autonomously attacks the nearest visible enemy in range with a replica of '''Aphelios' ''' current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, dealing {{as|{{pp|35 to 125 for 7|1 to 13}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pp|34 to 52 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} per hit. The sentry can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Aphelios|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage and benefits from both '''Aphelios'''' {{sti|attack speed|{{as|attack speed}}}} and {{sti|critical chance|{{as|critical strike chance}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
params.description3: ''See [[Aphelios#Pets|Pets]] for more details about the sentry.''
params.notes:
* While ''Sentry's'' attacks are modified by {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}}, it will {{tip|heal}} '''Aphelios''' for any damage it deals and its attacks cannot be intercepted by {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} and {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}}.
* The ''Sentry'' will stop upon colliding with {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}}. It will be deployed in front of the wall.
* The ''Sentry's'' attacks can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and {{tip|block|blocked}}, but not missed from being {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
<!--Blurb-->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' deploys a lunar sentry that gains a copy of his {{as|off-hand}} weapon and attacks with it, dealing {{as|physical damage}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Aphelios''' switches between his {{as|main weapon}} and {{as|off-hand}} weapon over {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
params.notes:
* Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* Switching does not interrupt '''any''' commands '''Aphelios''' was issued before or during ''Phase''.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Aphelios}} switches between his {{as|main weapon}} and {{as|off-hand}} weapon.
The icon of this ability reflects the next weapon that is in reserve.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' receives a text prompt of the weapon '''Alune''' will create next.
params.description: The icon of this ability reflects the next weapon that is in reserve.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' receives a text prompt of the weapon '''Alune''' will create next.
params.notes: * This ability also includes the icon of the {{as|off-hand}}.

params.name: Moonlight Vigil
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' casts forth a lunar spotlight in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of the area along its path and stops upon illuminating an enemy {{tip|champion|champion}}. '''Alune''' smites the area centered on the illuminated target, dealing {{as|{{pp|125 to 225 for 3|6 to 16}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} to enemy champions struck and locking-on to each target hit, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 2 seconds.
params.description2:
After {{fd|0.3}} seconds of the illumination, attacks based on '''Aphelios' ''' current {{as|main weapon}} will launch from the sky against each locked-on target, dealing {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. These attacks can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{critical damage|100 to 130|0 to 30|critScaling=true}} damage. There is no {{sti|range}} limit for locked-on targets.
{{lc|{{ai|Calibrum|Aphelios}}}} Applies an empowered mark that deals {{as|{{pp|50 to 110 for 3|6 to 16}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}}} per ''mark'' consumed.
{{lc|{{ai|Severum|Aphelios}}}} {{tip|Heals}} '''Aphelios''' for {{pp|250 to 450 for 3|6 to 16|color=heal}} if at least one enemy champion is hit.
{{lc|{{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}}}} Increases the initial {{tip|slow}} to 99% and empowers ''{{ai|Binding Eclipse|Aphelios}}'' to {{tip|root}} targets affected by the enhanced slow for {{fd|1.35}} seconds.
{{lc|{{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}}}} The initial blast deals {{as|{{pp|50 to 150 for 3|6 to 16}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.{{ft|The attack instead deals {{as|110% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} against locked-on targets, and causes an explosion of bolts in a 400-radius circle that deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|110*0.75*0.9 to 110*0.9 for 2|1 to 9}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to targets hit.|Performs ''Infernum's'' attacks and ''Infernum's'' bolts in a 400-radius circle: primary targets are dealt ''Infernum's'' primary damage; secondary targets are dealt 90% of ''Infernum's'' regular bolt damage; both are modified by ''Moonlight Vigil's'' {{sti|{{as|critical damage}}}} modifier.}}Enemy champions will take damage from overlapping areas.
{{lc|{{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}}}} Generates 5 additional spectral ''Chakrams'' that return to '''Aphelios''' from the first enemy champion hit, for a total of 6, on top of those from other targets hit.
params.notes:
* When critically striking, the attacks on locked-on targets when using {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} and {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}} deal slightly more than 120% damage.{{bug}} '''It is currently unknown where this damage originates from.'''
** For example, at level 6 with no {{sti|attack damage}} bonuses, '''Aphelios''' will deal {{as|{{ap|({{ccd|Aphelios|dam_base}}+{{ccd|Aphelios|dam_lvl}}*(6-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(6-1)))*(1.75-0.55)*1.05}}}} damage (approximated) from those attacks, whereas they are normally expected to deal {{as|{{ap|({{ccd|Aphelios|dam_base}}+{{ccd|Aphelios|dam_lvl}}*(6-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(6-1)))*(1.75-0.55)}}}}. This discrepancy increases with higher {{as|attack damage}}.
** {{Pending for test}} It is also unknown whether this is just a [[Practice Tool]] bug.
** {{sbc|Note:}} Values are outdated due to patch [[V26.01]].
* Attacks do not apply [[on-attack effects]].
* The attacks always count as {{tip|projectile|projectiles}} unless {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} is being used. The lunar spotlight, however, may always be intercepted regardless of which weapon is in play as the {{as|main weapon}}.
** Due to this fact, non-{{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} attacks will hit targets that are farther away from the center of the blast at a slightly longer delay.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block ''Moonlight Vigil's'' initial detonation damage but does not prevent the attacks from locking-on.
* All attacks from ''Moonlight Vigil'' {{tip|critically strike}} independently from each other.
** This includes {{ais|Infernum|Aphelios}} bolts, which also critically strike independently from the primary attack's damage.
* Changing weapons while ''Moonlight Vigil'' is in flight does not change the effect it has when it hits.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* ''Moonlight Vigil's'' effect radius is centered around the location of the missile as it collides.
* With {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}}, the extra flat heal is given only once, not per target. However, all damage done by ''Moonlight Vigil'' with it also heals him from ''Severum's '' own passive effect.
* With {{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}}, 14 fire bolts splash from each target hit (18 for {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}}). Bolts do not activate if ''Moonlight Vigil's'' initial damage [[kill]]s the target.
* With {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}}, 1 spectral chakram is generated for every target hit, meaning it is possible to generate up to 10 spectral chakrams with one cast of ''Moonlight Vigil'' if it hits 5 enemy champions.
* The locked-on attacks' can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and {{tip|block|blocked}}, but won't be prevented if '''Aphelios''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
** Preventing the attack also prevents the additional effect (e.g. marking them with {{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}} or granting {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios|spectral chakrams}}).
* ''Moonlight Vigil'' has different visual effects changed accordingly to each weapon. ''This may vary depending on the [[skin]], this showcases the '''default''':''
